Продуктовая аналитика.d: Sees what gets used and what does not
Продуктовая аналитика.res: You stop building the wrong things
Продуктовая аналитика.full: Sees what gets used and what does not: which features live, where people get stuck, what is opened once and forgotten. It shows you what you can leave unbuilt.
Продуктовая аналитика.lim: Collects no data beyond what is permitted
Продуктовая аналитика.pain: You build what is asked for loudest rather than what is actually used

Аналитик данных.d: Answers questions about the data in plain words
Аналитик данных.res: An answer in a minute instead of a ticket
Аналитик данных.full: Answers questions about the business in plain words: you ask in words, you get the number with the breakdown and an explanation of where it came from. It replaces the queue to the analyst with an answer in a minute.
Аналитик данных.lim: Does not draw conclusions where the data is thin, and says so honestly
Аналитик данных.pain: A simple number means going to the analyst and waiting a day

Качество данных.d: Catches duplicates, empty fields and junk
Качество данных.full: Catches the junk in your databases: duplicates, empty fields, broken formats, contradictions between systems. It tells you which reports can be trusted and which cannot yet.
Качество данных.pain: The reports look good but cannot be trusted because the database underneath is dirty

Исследователь пользователей.full: Prepares and analyses client interviews: the question script, the transcript, the recurring themes and the quotes. It turns conversations into conclusions instead of a folder of recordings.
Исследователь пользователей.lim: Does not replace findings with its own hypotheses
Исследователь пользователей.pain: Product decisions are made on the founder's intuition

Отчётность по расписанию.d: Sends the regular reports by itself
Отчётность по расписанию.res: Nobody has to ask for a report
Отчётность по расписанию.full: Sends the regular reports by itself: morning, weekly, monthly, subscribed per recipient. Nobody needs to ask for a report and wait.
Отчётность по расписанию.lim: Does not decide which metrics matter, that is configuration
Отчётность по расписанию.pain: A report has to be requested and arrives late

Чистильщик CRM.d: Cleans the base of duplicates and junk
Чистильщик CRM.full: Catches duplicate companies and contacts, normalises registration details, phone numbers and name spellings, and fills missing fields from open sources. Without it your analytics lies by exactly as much as the base underneath is dirty.
Чистильщик CRM.lim: Duplicates are merged only on confirmation
Чистильщик CRM.pain: One client sits in the base as three records and the analytics lies

Дашборд-агент.d: Collects the data and refreshes the dashboards
Дашборд-агент.full: Collects finished data from every agent's store and puts it into one layer the reports are drawn from. It runs on schedule and watches freshness and completeness, so the numbers on screen are today's.
Дашборд-агент.lim: Does not change data in the source systems
Дашборд-агент.pain: The numbers at the meeting are yesterday's and everyone brought their own version

Интеграции.full: Connects systems through APIs: sets up the exchange, watches the formats, catches breaks and retries the failed transfers. Data moves on its own, without manual exports.
Интеграции.lim: Never stores access keys in working files
Интеграции.pain: Data is moved by hand through exports and half of it gets lost

Комплаенс переписки.d: Watches that nothing sensitive leaves the perimeter
Комплаенс переписки.res: Prices, client base and deal terms protected
Комплаенс переписки.full: Watches whether prices, personal data and deal terms are leaving the perimeter. It catches the client base being forwarded and discounts discussed outside the rules, and raises the case for review.
Комплаенс переписки.lim: Does not read employees' private correspondence
Комплаенс переписки.pain: Prices and the client base leak into private chats and you never find out

Бэкапы.full: Makes backups on schedule and, more importantly, regularly checks that you can actually restore from them. A backup nobody has ever tested is not a backup.
Бэкапы.pain: The copies seem to exist but nobody has ever tried restoring from them

Контроль доступов.d: Tracks who has which rights and removes the extra ones
Контроль доступов.full: Tracks who has which rights in which systems and removes what should not be there: leavers, role changes, one off access somebody forgot to close. It reviews rights regularly rather than once a year.
Контроль доступов.lim: Does not grant new rights without approval
Контроль доступов.pain: People who left still have access and nobody ever checked

Реагирование на инциденты.full: Records incidents, builds the timeline, runs the review and makes sure the conclusion turns into a fix. It shortens the distance from «something happened» to «fixed and the cause is closed».
Реагирование на инциденты.lim: Does not communicate with external authorities
Реагирование на инциденты.pain: The incident was discussed verbally and forgotten, and a month later it happened again

Мониторинг и алерты.d: Watches the metrics and warns you
Мониторинг и алерты.full: Watches system metrics and warns on deviation: load, errors, response time, limits. It is tuned to wake you for something real rather than for every rustle.
Мониторинг и алерты.lim: Does not silence alerts on its own
Мониторинг и алерты.pain: The client tells you about the problem, not the system

Дежурный по сервисам.d: Watches that systems are alive and restarts what falls
Дежурный по сервисам.full: Checks around the clock that everything is alive: services respond, integrations work, queues are not growing. It restarts what fell by the runbook and wakes a person when it cannot cope alone.
Дежурный по сервисам.pain: The service went down at night and you heard about it in the morning from clients

Аудит логов.d: Checks who did what in the systems
Аудит логов.full: Checks who did what in the systems: access to sensitive data, changes, exports. It gives you the trail for a review and for auditors.
Аудит логов.lim: Read only, it never alters the logs
Аудит логов.pain: There is no way to reconstruct who touched the sensitive data

Главный ассистент.d: Orchestrates the other agents and reports to the owner
Главный ассистент.res: One door into the whole system
Главный ассистент.full: The single door into the whole system: it takes any request by text or voice, works out the area itself, calls the right agents and assembles one answer from theirs. Simple things it settles itself, complex ones it brings to you with a conclusion and a next step.
Главный ассистент.lim: Does not reveal private data without checking who is asking
Главный ассистент.pain: Every question has to be routed by hand, you are your own dispatcher

Заметки и знания.d: Stores and finds what you need from the archive
Заметки и знания.res: Nothing is lost in your head
Заметки и знания.full: Stores and finds what you need from the archive: notes, documents, decisions, scraps of thought. It searches by meaning rather than by exact wording, so it finds things you phrased differently at the time.
Заметки и знания.lim: Never moves private notes into other circuits
Заметки и знания.pain: You wrote it down and lost it, and now you are searching every messenger

Личный помощник.d: Answers questions and handles the small tasks
Личный помощник.res: Your head gets its space back
Личный помощник.full: Works through the stream of small matters and questions: answers the simple ones, sets reminders, prepares briefs, holds the context across every topic. It runs constantly, which is why its load is the highest in the system.
Личный помощник.lim: Does not make decisions for the owner
Личный помощник.pain: Small things eat the day and the important work starts in the evening

Тревел-агент.full: Assembles the whole trip: flights, hotels, route, visa timings, documents. It reminds you what to pack and watches for flight changes.
Тревел-агент.lim: Does not pay for bookings itself
Тревел-агент.pain: Trips are assembled by hand and visa timings are remembered at the last moment

Почтальон.d: Sorts the mail and pulls out what matters
Почтальон.res: The inbox stops eating your time
Почтальон.full: Sorts the mail: separates what matters from newsletters, pulls out what needs an answer or a decision, drafts replies to the routine. It sends an evening digest instead of you digging through the inbox.
Почтальон.pain: The inbox eats an hour a day and the important things sink among newsletters

Календарь дня.d: Keeps the schedule and reminds you
Календарь дня.full: Keeps the schedule: meetings, deadlines, reminders, buffers between things. It builds the plan in the morning and closes the day in the evening, and watches for clashes in the calendar.
Календарь дня.lim: Does not move other people's meetings without agreement
Календарь дня.pain: The day falls apart and meetings run into each other

Психолог.res: Your resource does not burn out
Психолог.full: Works with your state: anxiety, fatigue, difficult conversations, doubts about decisions. It reflects the state back, separates facts from interpretations and leads to one concrete step. Fully isolated from the business circuit.
Психолог.lim: Does not diagnose, and points you to a real specialist when the risk is acute
Психолог.pain: Tension builds up and comes out on the team and on decisions

Ментор.d: Works through decisions and strategy with the owner
Ментор.full: Works through decisions and strategy: it pulls vague plans back to numbers, dates and owners, and names the compromise you are avoiding out loud. A sparring partner rather than a reference book, and it is allowed to disagree.
Ментор.lim: Does not take operational or financial questions
Ментор.pain: There is nobody to think decisions through with, and your own view is worn smooth

Пульс здоровья.full: Watches wellbeing and routine through short check-ins morning and evening: sleep, energy, load. It builds the picture over time and warns you when you are heading off the rails.
Пульс здоровья.pain: You run yourself into the ground and notice only once you are burnt out

Личные финансы.d: Keeps the personal budget and spending
Личные финансы.res: You can see where the money goes
Личные финансы.full: Keeps the personal budget separately from the business: spending by category, subscriptions, recurring payments. It shows where the money actually goes, without judgement or lectures.
Личные финансы.lim: Never mixes with the company's finances
Личные финансы.pain: Money goes out and it is unclear exactly where
